tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the TCLP knowledge graph using fusion search (semantic + BM25).

    Args:
        query: Free-text search query (max 1000 characters).
        node_type: Content scope — "tclp" (clauses, glossary terms, guides) or "all".
            Laws, regulations, standards and frameworks are not searcha

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description:
Find TCLP content (clauses, glossary terms, guides) associated with a named concept.

    Unlike `search`, this performs a deterministic name match against Entity nodes in
    the knowledge graph rather than a relevance-ranked semantic search. Use it when
    you have a specific term or concept (e.g

tools.name: find_legal_resources
tools.description:
Find the laws, regulations, standards, frameworks and guidance that TCLP content refers to.

    This is not a general legal database: it holds only the instruments that TCLP
    clauses, guides and glossary terms cite.

    Status "stub": identity confirmed, metadata minimal; a null or empty field

tools.name: get_legal_resource
tools.description:
Get one law, regulation, standard, framework or guidance, and the TCLP content citing it.

    Versions are not tracked yet, so every citation has `staleness: "unpinned"`:
    the content cites the instrument without naming a version. There is no
    description yet; do not supply one from your own

tools.name: taxonomy_facets
tools.description:
List taxonomy facets and their value slugs across TCLP content.

    Facets are taxonomy categories like `sector`, `practice_area`,
    `application`, and `jurisdiction`. Each facet returns the list of slugs
    that actually appear on the graph, with counts. Use this to discover
    the vocabulary,

tools.name: taxonomy_content
tools.description:
List TCLP content (clauses, guides) or legal resources filtered by taxonomy facet=value.

    Multi-facet filters are combined with AND. Call `taxonomy_facets` first
    to learn which facet names and slugs exist; using a name not in that
    list returns a 400.

    Args:
        filters: Mapping o

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
